note: A capability throws or comes back empty. The model-free system cannot invent a different intent, but the planner already ranked runner-ups for the same clause, so it can try the next-best action and say which one it tried. Each task names the faults the host injects and the effects (capability ids, in order) a recovering host must produce. Baseline is the site the panel shipped before this rung (execute, recover off): it makes the call, the handler throws, and the plan ends there. 'boundary' tasks are the failures that should stay failures: they are scored, not excluded, so the number does not improve by narrowing the suite.
